rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analyzed

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: underInvestigationFor

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ai

Class that describes a build instance of software/artifacts.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: executable

For AI training dataset, test dataset, test artifact, configuration data, build input data, and build output data, please consider using the more specific relationship types: `trainedOn`, `testedOn`, `hasTest`, `configures`, `hasInput`, and `hasOutput`, respectively.
